defmodule CartPricing.Sales.Calculations.CartQuote do
  use Ash.Resource.Calculation
  require Ash.Query

  def load(query, _context, _opts) do
    # Ensure items are loaded, and each item has its discounted_line_total_cents precomputed
    # so calculate/3 receives populated records.
    [items: [Ash.Resource.Calculations.DiscountedLineTotal]]
  end

  def calculate(cart, context, _opts) do
    # Support calls passing inputs in different ways.
    input = context[:input] || context[:args] || %{}
    coupon_code = Map.get(input, :coupon_code)
    as_of = Map.get(input, :as_of)

    calc_quote(cart, coupon_code, as_of)
  end

  def calc_quote(cart, coupon_code, as_of) do
    items = cart.items || []
    gross_subtotal = Enum.sum(Enum.map(items, &Map.get(&1, :line_total_cents, 0)))
    subtotal = Enum.sum(Enum.map(items, &Map.get(&1, :discounted_line_total_cents, 0)))
    tier_discount = gross_subtotal - subtotal
    item_count = length(items)

    {coupon_status, coupon_discount} = resolve_coupon(coupon_code, as_of, subtotal)
    discounted_subtotal = subtotal - coupon_discount

    tax = calc_tax(cart.region, discounted_subtotal)
    total = discounted_subtotal + tax

    %{
      gross_subtotal_cents: gross_subtotal,
      tier_discount_cents: tier_discount,
      subtotal_cents: subtotal,
      coupon_status: coupon_status,
      coupon_discount_cents: coupon_discount,
      discounted_subtotal_cents: discounted_subtotal,
      tax_cents: tax,
      total_cents: total,
      item_count: item_count
    }
  end

  defp resolve_coupon(nil, _as_of, _subtotal), do: {:none, 0}

  defp resolve_coupon(coupon_code, as_of, subtotal) do
    query = Ash.Query.filter(CartPricing.Sales.Coupon, code == ^coupon_code)

    coupon = Ash.read_one!(query, domain: CartPricing.Sales)

    cond do
      is_nil(coupon) -> {:not_found, 0}
      DateTime.compare(as_of, coupon.starts_at) == :lt -> {:not_yet_active, 0}
      DateTime.compare(as_of, coupon.ends_at) == :gt -> {:expired, 0}
      not is_nil(coupon.max_redemptions) and coupon.redemption_count >= coupon.max_redemptions ->
        {:exhausted, 0}
      subtotal < coupon.min_subtotal_cents -> {:below_minimum, 0}
      true -> {:applied, apply_discount(subtotal, coupon)}
    end
  end

  defp apply_discount(subtotal, coupon) do
    discount = div(subtotal * coupon.percent_off_bps, 10_000)

    if coupon.max_discount_cents != nil do
      min(discount, coupon.max_discount_cents)
    else
      discount
    end
  end

  defp calc_tax(:us_ca, subtotal), do: round_half_away_from_zero(subtotal * 925)
  defp calc_tax(:us_or, subtotal), do: 0
  defp calc_tax(:eu_de, subtotal), do: round_half_to_even(subtotal * 1900)
  defp calc_tax(:jp_13, subtotal), do: truncate_toward_zero(subtotal * 1000)

  # Each calc returns an integer by dividing the whole-number bps product by 10000.
  defp round_half_away_from_zero(n)
       when n >= 0, do: div(n + 5000, 10_000)

  defp round_half_away_from_zero(n),
    do: div(n - 5000, 10_000)

  defp round_half_to_even(n) do
    # Using exact rational arithmetic via big integers to implement unbiased rounding.
    # target = n / 10000.
    # We want the nearest integer; half-way cases round to the even neighbor.
    whole = div(n, 10_000)
    remainder = rem(n, 10_000)
    rem_abs = abs(remainder)

    cond do
      rem_abs > 5000 -> whole + (if n >= 0, do: 1, else: -1)
      rem_abs < 5000 -> whole
      true ->
        # exactly half-way: round to nearest even
        if even?(whole), do: whole, else: whole + (if n >= 0, do: 1, else: -1)
    end
  end

  defp truncate_toward_zero(n), do: div(n, 10_000)

  defp even?(n), do: rem(n, 2) == 0
end
